target_customer: Developers and companies running AI agents that need persistent Linux sandboxes
problem: AI agents need full, persistent machines with SSH, Docker and desktop access rather than ephemeral containers. boat sells Ubuntu VM sandboxes with snapshot forking.
business_model: Usage-based cloud VMs, pricing from $20 per month after a 7-day trial per a directory listing

founders.name: Anicet Nougaret
founders.background_notes: EveryDev lists him as both CEO and CTO in different places.

founders.name: Kirill
founders.background_notes: Surname not given on the YC page.

competitors.name: E2B
competitors.what: Firecracker microVM sandboxes for AI agents

competitors.name: Fly.io Sprites
competitors.what: Stateful Firecracker sandboxes for coding agents

technical_complexity.rationale: VM orchestration, snapshot forking and networking across European regions is standard infrastructure engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded sandbox providers sell similar VMs and compete on price; differentiation rests on persistence and cheap pricing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-resourced players were already selling the same wedge in 2026.

market_need_then: Agent builders adopted sandboxes widely in 2025 and 2026; a testimonial from Theo Browne (t3.gg) says boat unblocked his agents, and the site lists customers such as Tella, Morph and Squad (unverified).

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, playful nautical touches such as Set sail and a Battleships reference

branding.brand_signature: Lowercase boat wordmark with nautical wordplay
branding.community_and_virality: Public endorsement from developer Theo Browne on the site

brand_strength.rationale: Short memorable word but generic and hard to search; a single influencer endorsement and nothing else found.

outcome_analysis: boat is a Fall 2026 Paris company that is active and too young for an outcome. It sells VM sandboxes into a fast-growing agent market but competes with well-funded rivals, and no round beyond YC has been confirmed.
notes: Directory listings give a founding year of 2026 versus 2024 on YC; EveryDev says the company began as Dedale AI operating as Ascii. Relationship between boat.dev and the Ascii box product is unconfirmed. E2B round date is from its own blog, not read in full. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
